mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(l.quantity * COALESCE(l.unit_cost_cents, 0)), 0) FROM cabinet_order_line l

SELECT l.sku_id AS c0, COALESCE(SUM(l.quantity), 0) AS c1 FROM cabinet_order_line l JOIN cabinet_order o ON l.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.device_id = #{deviceId} AND o.created_at >= #{since} GROUP BY l.sku_id
SELECT l.sku_id AS c0, COALESCE(SUM(l.quantity), 0) AS c1 FROM cabinet_order_line l JOIN cabinet_order o ON l.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.created_at >= #{since} GROUP BY l.sku_id

SELECT l.sku_id AS c0, DATE(timezone('Asia/Shanghai', o.created_at)) AS c1, COALESCE(SUM(l.quantity), 0) AS c2 FROM cabinet_order_line l JOIN cabinet_order o ON l.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.created_at >= #{since} GROUP BY l.sku_id, DATE(timezone('Asia/Shanghai', o.created_at))

SELECT l.slot_id AS c0, l.sku_id AS c1, l.sku_name AS c2, COALESCE(SUM(l.quantity), 0) AS c3, COALESCE(SUM(l.line_amount_cents), 0) AS c4 FROM cabinet_order_line l JOIN cabinet_order o ON l.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.device_id = #{deviceId} AND o.created_at >= #{since} AND l.slot_id IS NOT NULL AND l.slot_id <> '' GROUP BY l.slot_id, l.sku_id, l.sku_name

SELECT l.sku_id AS c0, l.sku_name AS c1, COALESCE(SUM(l.quantity), 0) AS c2, COALESCE(SUM(l.line_amount_cents), 0) AS c3, COALESCE(SUM(l.quantity * COALESCE(l.unit_cost_cents, 0)), 0) AS c4 FROM cabinet_order_line l JOIN cabinet_order o ON l.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.created_at >= #{since} GROUP BY l.sku_id, l.sku_name ORDER BY SUM(l.line_amount_cents) DESC

SELECT l.sku_id AS c0, l.sku_name AS c1, COALESCE(SUM(l.quantity), 0) AS c2, COALESCE(SUM(l.line_amount_cents), 0) AS c3, COALESCE(SUM(l.quantity * COALESCE(l.unit_cost_cents, 0)), 0) AS c4 FROM cabinet_order_line l JOIN cabinet_order o ON l.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.device_id IN #{__item} AND o.created_at >= #{since} GROUP BY l.sku_id, l.sku_name ORDER BY SUM(l.line_amount_cents) DESC
